name: My Giant Sexy Sensei Bullies Me 10
storyline: With Yuna out sick, Hinata has full control over you, and she shows no mercy when bullying you. Kirita and Hinata gleefully torment you with sadistic glee throughout your entire university day, giving you no time to rest. Hinata's secret sadistic side is on full display today, showing you that despite being smaller, she's far fiercer and more violent than Yuna.
summary: Experience a day of being bullied by Hinata and Kirita, your 2 sadistic, soft, cute, sexy, big-breasted friends.
